# Fanya Young

> Innovation Attorney, AI Governance Counsel, and Legal Technologist. California-licensed attorney with 17+ years of practice bridging law, technology, and operations.

This site presents Fanya Young's professional portfolio: legal practice (AI governance, general counsel, commercial contracts, legal operations, litigation) and a body of service-design and AI research case studies from leading enterprises.

- [Articles](/attorney/articles): Essays on AI law, governance, and legal innovation.
- [LG Project](/projects/lg): Service-design and process-optimization case study.
- [MGM Project](/projects/mgm): Strategic research and service-design case study.
- [Walmart Project](/projects/walmart): Multiple-shipment delivery research case study.
- [Sam's Club Project](/projects/samsclub): Member-experience optimization case study.
